Bigg Boss Bangla Season 3 Premieres After Decade-Long Hiatus

The reality television show 'Bigg Boss Bangla' has returned for its third season after a nearly ten-year absence. The new season features a new set of contestants and a house reportedly constructed in two and a half months, spanning 7,000 square feet. The premiere marks the revival of the show after its last season concluded almost a decade ago.
